entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A for the State.

2.  This bail application has been filed by the applicant in Case Crime No. 728 of 2023, under Sections - 498A, 304B I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station- Tronika City,
District- Ghaziabad with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has falsely implicated in this case.
Applicant is husband of deceased.
It was stated that it was a love marriage between them.
The marriage has taken place in the year 2018 and they have two children.
There is no specific allegation of dowry demand.
It was submitted that deceased has suffered injuries by falling from stairs and after the incident she was taken to hospital.

The injuries shown in Shariq vs State Of U.P. on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135321606/
1 postmortem report also corroborate that deceased has suffered death due to falling from stairs.
Referring to the facts of the matter, it was submitted that applicant has no motive to cause death of deceased.
Lastly, it was stated that applicant is in jail since 16.01.2024, having no criminal history and that in case applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.

4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is husband of deceased and in the first information report there are allegations that she was harassed and assaulted by the applicant and his family members.
It was submitted that deceased was brutally assaulted and after that she was taken to hospital and she has died due to injuries sustained by her.

5. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations and all attending facts, particularly considering the injuries sustained by the deceased, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, no case for grant of bail is made out.
6. Accordingly, the instant bail application filed on behalf of applicant Shariq is rejected.
7. However, considering facts of the matter, the Trial Court is directed to expedite the trial and conclude the same, as early as possible, if there is no other legal impediment.
8. A copy of this order be transmitted to the Trial Court concerned for necessary compliance.

Order Date :- 8.1.2025 SK Srivastava  Shariq vs State Of U.P. on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135321606/
